problem.title: Wigner negativity costs phase-space area: A conjectured refinement of the Lieb--Solovej inequality at Rényi order one half
problem.question: Extract a small falsifiable subproblem from this attributed abstract sentence: We conjecture that the Wigner logarithmic negativity of any single-mode state is bounded by the amount by which the Rényi-$1/2$ entropy of its Husimi function exceeds the coherent-state value, with equality only for coherent states.

text.subclaim: The Husimi function of any single-mode state has Rényi-$1/2$ entropy greater than or equal to the coherent-state value.
text.assumptions: 1) assume the Wigner logarithmic negativity is bounded by the amount by which the Rényi-$1/2$ entropy of its Husimi function exceeds the coherent-state value (conjecture).
text.derivation: Step 1: Assume that a single-mode state has a Husimi function H. Step 2: Compute the Rényi-$1/2$ entropy of H, denoted by S(H). Step 3: Note that if the Wigner logarithmic negativity of the state is bounded, then S(H) must be greater than or equal to the coherent-state value (from conjecture).
text.falsifier: To check this subclaim, one could compute the Husimi function and Rényi-$1/2$ entropy for a variety of single-mode states and verify that they indeed satisfy S(H) >= coherent-state value.
text.next_check: Check if any state with zero Wigner logarithmic negativity has zero Rényi-$1/2$ entropy.
